headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (13)

summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Chinese Grand Prix from pole position, 5.5s ahead of George Russell, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Carlos Sainz made the biggest climb, from P17 to P9.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised OCO (10 second time penalty).
There were 19 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
George Russell leads the championship by 4 points over Kimi Antonelli.
